854:     contingency = _contingency_matrix(reference_indices, estimated_indices).astype(
855:         float
856:     )
857:     contingency = np.array(contingency, dtype="float")
858:     # Calculate the MI for the two clusterings
859:     mi = _mutual_info_score(
860:         reference_indices, estimated_indices, contingency=contingency
861:     )
862:     # Calculate the expected value for the mutual information
863:     # Calculate entropy for each labeling
864:     h_true, h_pred = _entropy(reference_indices), _entropy(estimated_indices)
865:     nmi = mi / max(np.sqrt(h_true * h_pred), 1e-10)
866:     return nmi
867: 
868: 
869: def mutual_information(
870:     reference_intervals,
871:     reference_labels,
872:     estimated_intervals,
873:     estimated_labels,
874:     frame_size=0.1,
875: ):
876:     """Frame-clustering segmentation: mutual information metrics.
877: 
878:     Examples
879:     --------
880:     >>> (ref_intervals,
881:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
882:     >>> (est_intervals,
883:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
884:     >>> # Trim or pad the estimate to match reference timing
885:     >>> (ref_intervals,
886:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(ref_intervals,
887:     ...                                               ref_labels,
888:     ...                                               t_min=0)
889:     >>> (est_intervals,
890:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
891:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, t_min=0, t_max=ref_intervals.max())
892:     >>> mi, ami, nmi = mir_eval.structure.mutual_information(ref_intervals,
893:     ...                                                      ref_labels,
894:     ...                                                      est_intervals,
895:     ...                                                      est_labels)
896: 
897:     Parameters
898:     ----------
899:     reference_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(n, 2)
900:         reference segment intervals, in the format returned by
901:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
902:     reference_labels : list, shape=(n,)
903:         reference segment labels, in the format returned by
904:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
905:     estimated_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(m, 2)
906:         estimated segment intervals, in the format returned by
907:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
908:     estimated_labels : list, shape=(m,)
909:         estimated segment labels, in the format returned by
910:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
911:     frame_size : float > 0
912:         length (in seconds) of frames for clustering
913:         (Default value = 0.1)
914: 
915:     Returns
916:     -------
917:     MI : float > 0
918:         Mutual information between segmentations
919:     AMI : float
920:         Adjusted mutual information between segmentations.
921:     NMI : float > 0
922:         Normalize mutual information between segmentations
923: 
924:     """
925:     validate_structure(
926:         reference_intervals, reference_labels, estimated_intervals, estimated_labels
927:     )
928: 
929:     # Check for empty annotations.  Don't need to check labels because
930:     # validate_structure makes sure they're the same size as intervals
931:     if reference_intervals.size == 0 or estimated_intervals.size == 0:
932:         return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
933: 
934:     # Generate the cluster labels
935:     y_ref = util.intervals_to_samples(
936:         reference_intervals, reference_labels, sample_size=frame_size
937:     )[-1]
938: 
939:     y_ref = util.index_labels(y_ref)[0]
940: 
941:     # Map to index space
942:     y_est = util.intervals_to_samples(
943:         estimated_intervals, estimated_labels, sample_size=frame_size
944:     )[-1]
945: 
946:     y_est = util.index_labels(y_est)[0]
947: 
948:     # Mutual information
949:     mutual_info = _mutual_info_score(y_ref, y_est)
950: 
951:     # Adjusted mutual information
952:     adj_mutual_info = _adjusted_mutual_info_score(y_ref, y_est)
953: 
954:     # Normalized mutual information
955:     norm_mutual_info = _normalized_mutual_info_score(y_ref, y_est)
956: 
957:     return mutual_info, adj_mutual_info, norm_mutual_info
958: 
959: 
960: def nce(
961:     reference_intervals,
962:     reference_labels,
963:     estimated_intervals,
964:     estimated_labels,
965:     frame_size=0.1,
966:     beta=1.0,
967:     marginal=False,
968: ):
969:     """Frame-clustering segmentation: normalized conditional entropy
970: 
971:     Computes cross-entropy of cluster assignment, normalized by the
972:     max-entropy.
973: 
974:     Examples
975:     --------
976:     >>> (ref_intervals,
977:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
978:     >>> (est_intervals,
979:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
980:     >>> # Trim or pad the estimate to match reference timing
981:     >>> (ref_intervals,
982:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(ref_intervals,
983:     ...                                               ref_labels,
984:     ...                                               t_min=0)
985:     >>> (est_intervals,
986:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
987:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, t_min=0, t_max=ref_intervals.max())
988:     >>> S_over, S_under, S_F = mir_eval.structure.nce(ref_intervals,
989:     ...                                               ref_labels,
990:     ...                                               est_intervals,
991:     ...                                               est_labels)
992: 
993:     Parameters
994:     ----------
995:     reference_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(n, 2)
996:         reference segment intervals, in the format returned by
997:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
998:     reference_labels : list, shape=(n,)
999:         reference segment labels, in the format returned by
1000:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1001:     estimated_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(m, 2)
1002:         estimated segment intervals, in the format returned by
1003:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1004:     estimated_labels : list, shape=(m,)
1005:         estimated segment labels, in the format returned by
1006:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1007:     frame_size : float > 0
1008:         length (in seconds) of frames for clustering
1009:         (Default value = 0.1)
